remarks:
Tucked away in the Enchanted Mountains of Cattaraugus County, this secluded hilltop cabin is a nature lover’s dream! Set on 14.43 acres of wooded privacy, this rustic retreat offers peace, quiet, and a true off-grid lifestyle.

Thoughtfully updated while preserving its charm, the cabin features a 1-year-old metal roof extended over the front porch, two brand-new skylights, fresh paint, and an interior renovation completed in 2024—including all-new insulation, walls, and brand-new floor throughout. A new addition provides space for a bathroom, enhancing comfort while keeping the charm intact.

The cozy interior includes an open kitchen/great room with a wood-burning fireplace and one bedroom for comfortable overnight stays. Step outside to a spacious deck that invites you to relax and soak in the peaceful surroundings—perfect for morning coffee or stargazing at night.

Love animals? You might just have a few visitors—deer, bears, chipmunks, and more are frequent guests in these woods, making this the ultimate wildlife lover’s retreat.

Whether you're looking for a peaceful weekend escape, a hunting basecamp, or a place to unplug and reconnect with nature, this cabin checks all the boxes.
